title: Orchestrator and external reader reach probes and status page without credentials
asA: orchestrator, load balancer, or external reader that has no service credentials
iWant: the liveness path, readiness path, and status page path to be exempt from every authentication gate the application applies to other paths
soThat: the probes are usable by the systems that operate the deployment and the status page is usable by the readers it is written for

acceptanceCriteria.description: The liveness, readiness, and status page paths respond to a GET carrying no cookie, no Authorization header, and no session token, with a 2xx response (or a 5xx that reflects the probe answer, not an auth challenge); no path returns 401 or 403 to an unauthenticated request.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running with the application's normal authentication middleware active
acceptanceCriteria.when: unauthenticated GETs are issued against each of the three paths in turn
acceptanceCriteria.then: no response carries status code 401 or 403 and none carries a WWW-Authenticate response header; each response is either a 2xx probe pass, a 5xx probe fail, or a 2xx status page

acceptanceCriteria.description: The three paths are declared at boot as auth-exempt in the application's authentication middleware; the exempt list is inspectable from the running process (through configuration read or a debug endpoint operators use in staging).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running with an auth-exempt path list declared in configuration
acceptanceCriteria.when: the running process's exempt list is inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the list contains the three configured paths (liveness, readiness, status page) and no others that were not deliberately declared

acceptanceCriteria.description: A request that carries valid authentication credentials against one of the three exempt paths still receives the probe or status-page response; the exemption is one-directional (auth not required), not one that refuses authenticated callers.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running with valid credentials available to the caller
acceptanceCriteria.when: an authenticated GET is issued against each of the three exempt paths
acceptanceCriteria.then: each response is identical in shape and status code to the unauthenticated case; no path refuses the authenticated caller
